evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a game with name/description; other game stories cover inviting, browsing, deleting, or transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-028 (limit) and PP-029 (joining); this is specifically the moderator invitation mechanism via URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; other item-related stories address listing/selecting/CRUD/import, not starting a round via entering an item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar theme to PP-031 but different actor (moderator vs estimator) and intent; not a duplicate under QUS.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-013 (re-estimate earlier story) and PP-006/007/008 (CRUD); this is selection of current item.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD operation; not duplicated by edit/delete or import/copy-paste.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD operation; no other story expresses editing items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Unique CRUD operation; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-033 (show after all estimates) and PP-036 (who gave what); this is early reveal by moderator.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-011 (auto-fill when unanimous) and PP-012 (manual entry); this is accepting computed average.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from PP-010 (average) and PP-012 (manual entry).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry is distinct from accepting average (PP-010) or auto-fill on unanimity (PP-011).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; related to selection (PP-005) but adds explicit business goal of re-estimating earlier story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with PP-015 (copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet) as both express bringing stories from a spreadsheet into the game; difference in mechanism is not a meaningful requirement distinction at this level.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-014’s requirement to get stories from a spreadsheet into the system; one is substantially contained in the other without a clear business-rule difference.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from viewing/exporting transcripts (PP-017/018/019) and deleting games (PP-020).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Different from exporting transcripts (PP-018/019); viewing is separate from exporting formats.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-019 (CSV export) due to different output format/goal.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-018 (HTML export) due to different output format/goal.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; separate from deleting an account (PP-024) and deleting items (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login (PP-022), change details (PP-023), delete account (PP-024), and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Unique authentication action; not duplicated by account creation or password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from create/delete account and password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from deleting a game (PP-020) and other account operations.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story covers timezone display.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from login and account creation/change; no duplicate password recovery story.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Unique configuration requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Not a duplicate of PP-002; PP-002 is about inviting via URL, while this adds a specific capacity constraint/business rule.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from moderator inviting (PP-002) and account login (PP-022); this is estimator join flow.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates estimator viewing of the current item; PP-005 is moderator selecting item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Similar to PP-004 but different actor/role; allowed as separate requirement per QUS guidance.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-033 (reveal actual estimates after all) and PP-036 (who gave what estimates); this is status/participation indicator.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Different from PP-009 (show immediately before all) and PP-036 (see who gave what during round) due to timing/trigger and purpose (independence).

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-041, which also allows changing an estimate until the draw is completed; same actor (participant) and same permission window.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from PP-039 (scroll back through stories/estimates) by focusing on per-estimator prior estimates for the current story.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-032 (who has estimated) and PP-033 (simultaneous reveal after all); this is mapping estimator-to-estimate for the round.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from PP-038 (auto-reset behavior); no other story duplicates starting the timer.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Unique behavior requirement; complements but does not duplicate PP-037.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Not duplicated; differs from PP-035 (per-estimator prior estimates for current story) and moderator transcript viewing/export (PP-017-019).

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses consistent card ordering.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034’s requirement to allow changing an estimate until the reveal/draw completion; no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Unique personalization/UI requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from accessibility (PP-047) and browser compatibility (PP-046); standards compliance is a separate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates glossary/definitions.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Unique technical requirement; not duplicated by general performance story PP-048 (different level/means).

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Unique cross-browser compatibility requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Distinct from XHTML/CSS standards (PP-043) and performance (PP-048); accessibility is separate.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General performance requirement; not a duplicate of PP-045 (specific implementation approach: indexes).

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates Unicode/language support.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Unique usability/URL design requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates error page requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Unique privacy/anonymization requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates usage metrics requirement.
